entries.name: opencv-python-headless
entries.notes: T2 video ingest. Exact pin opencv-python-headless==4.10.0.84. CI wheel (cp37-abi3, manylinux x86_64): opencv_python_headless-4.10.0.84-cp37-abi3-manylinux_2_17_x86_64.manylinux2014_x86_64.whl. sha256 copied from the PyPI JSON API digests.sha256 for that filename. 4.10.0.84 ships FFmpeg 5.1 (avcodec 59.x), OpenSSL 1.1.1w, OpenBLAS, libgfortran, libquadmath, libpng, and libvpx, plus the static libraries listed in cv2.getBuildInformation() 3rdparty dependencies. It does not ship libaom, dav1d, libavif, or libdrm (those appear in later 4.14+ wheels).
